cases.sentence: Блажен всякий, боящийся Господа и ходящий Его ___.
cases.explain: The adjective Его (his) requires agreement; ходящий путями (walking in ways) uses instrumental case.

cases.sentence: Ты будешь есть плоды ___ своих рук.
cases.explain: The genitive case is used for possession: плоды труда (the fruits of labor).

cases.sentence: Блажен ты, и ___ будет у тебя.
cases.explain: Процветание is the subject of the verb будет (will be), requiring nominative case.

cases.sentence: Жена твоя будет, как плодовитая ___ в твоем доме.
cases.explain: Лоза is the predicate nominative after будет (will be), requiring nominative case.

cases.sentence: Твои ___ будут, как ветви маслин вокруг твоего стола.
cases.explain: Дети is the subject of будут (will be), requiring nominative case.

cases.sentence: Твои дети будут, как ветви маслин вокруг твоего ___.
cases.explain: The preposition вокруг (around) with prepositional case indicates position: вокруг столе (around the table).

cases.sentence: Да благословит тебя Господь ___, да увидишь ты процветание Иерусалима.
cases.explain: The construction 'Господь Сиона' (the Lord of Zion) uses the genitive to indicate possession.

cases.sentence: Да увидишь ты процветание Иерусалима во все ___ своей жизни.
cases.explain: The phrase все дни (all the days) requires accusative case for duration of time: во все дни (throughout all days).

reading.ru: Блажен всякий, боящийся Господа и ходящий Его путями.
reading.question: Who is blessed according to this verse?
options: Everyone who fears the Lord and walks in his ways
reading.correct: Everyone who fears the Lord and walks in his ways
reading.explain: The verse explicitly states that blessed is 'everyone who fears the Lord and walks in his ways.'

reading.ru: Ты будешь есть плоды труда своих рук.
reading.question: What blessing results from living this way?
options: You will eat the fruit of your own labor
reading.correct: You will eat the fruit of your own labor
reading.explain: The text promises 'You will eat the fruit of your labor' — the fruits of one's own work.

reading.ru: Жена твоя будет, как плодовитая лоза в твоем доме.
reading.question: What metaphor is used to describe the wife?
options: A fruitful vine in your house
reading.correct: A fruitful vine in your house
reading.explain: The verse compares the wife to 'a fruitful vine in your house,' suggesting abundance and fruitfulness.

reading.ru: Твои дети будут, как ветви маслин вокруг твоего стола.
reading.question: What comparison is made about one's children?
options: Like olive branches around your table
reading.correct: Like olive branches around your table
reading.explain: The verse describes children as 'like olive branches around your table,' suggesting a large and blessed family.

reading.ru: Так будет благословлен человек, боящийся Господа.
reading.question: What is the conclusion about the God-fearing person?
options: Thus shall such a person be blessed
Such a person will be ignored
Such a person will be alone
reading.correct: Thus shall such a person be blessed
reading.explain: The verse affirms: 'Thus is the man blessed who fears the Lord.'

reading.question: How does the psalm conclude?
reading.explain: The psalm ends with 'Мир Израилю!' — 'Peace to Israel.'
